captured: 2026-11-15, 1440x900, homepage only, logged out. Elements hidden at opacity 0 before reveal were skipped by the extractor, so light-section colours are partly from screenshots (~approx).

spacing.notes: Most frequent: 12px (62), 40px (29), 32px (28 + 23 as column gap), 8px (20). Section padding 72px and 128px. Nav padding 16px 32px.

typography.notes: Variable-font weights step in 20-60 units rather than 400/700 jumps. Uppercase 14px with 0.28px tracking on 10 elements (wordmark, eyebrow labels).

shadows: single-layer rgba(0,0,0,0.05), 1 use (nav on scroll); media tiles have none

motion.hero: video bracketed by a still start frame and a still end frame (both 2.67:1), so the hero rests on a still image
motion.reduced_motion: true; reveal classes are prefixed motion-safe:

taste.name: Three-speed motion with one shape
taste.trigger: When animating a product that handles people's money
taste.decision: Chose a small fixed set of durations (150ms hover colour, 300ms state change, 500ms image exit) on a decelerating curve over per-component springs or bounces
taste.reason: Because motion that always ends the same way, and ends quickly, feels like a steady hand; surprise motion near money reads as risk
evidence: all reveal classes gated by motion-safe:

taste.name: Every claim carries its footnote
taste.trigger: When making strong product claims in the hero
taste.decision: Chose superscript footnote markers on claims, a plain 12-14px disclosure strip inside the hero, and a numbered footnote list at the end over unqualified headline promises
taste.reason: Because people trust a claim more when they can see exactly where its limits are written down
evidence: superscript marker on the hero subhead
disclosure strip at the bottom of the hero, #1E1E2A fill, ~13px
8 numbered footnotes at 12px/16.8px in the footer area

taste.name: Weight steps of 20-60, not 400 to 700
taste.trigger: When building heading and body hierarchy
taste.decision: Chose variable-font weights 360/400/420/480 with size doing the heavy lifting over a regular/bold pair
taste.reason: Because small weight steps keep headlines calm and spoken rather than shouted, which suits a product asking for trust

taste.name: Hero that comes to rest
taste.trigger: When using video in the hero
taste.decision: Chose a clip bracketed by a still first frame and a still last frame over an endless looping background video
taste.reason: Because a scene that settles lets the reader start reading; a loop keeps pulling the eye away from the words
evidence: no infinite iteration counts in any running animation
